assessments.title: ICT Market Structure Notes
assessments.reason: Specific FVG entry and invalidation context found.
assessments.snippet: A bullish fair value gap forms after bullish displacement. Entry is considered on the retracement into the gap during the New York session when higher-timeframe bias remains bullish. Invalidation is a candle-body close below the gap low.
